decisions.reason: Visibility rose from a mention to a page of its own in 2024, which suggests results meet the aspiration in the firm's core safety shoe business, and the large firm has the slack to keep developing it.

The comfort insole stayed at the level of a mention with no sign of growth, but it is a cheap complement to the core shoes and fits the firm's tailored-fit offer, so there is little shortfall to trigger search.
Like B, the supportive insole holds steady at low visibility and costs little to carry, though it could be folded into the more successful moulded insole range if management looks to streamline.
The ergonomic series has kept a dedicated page in both years, indicating steady results in line with the firm's innovation goals.
The firefighter and rescue boots moved up to a page of their own in 2024, a sign of satisfactory uptake in a specialist segment that suits the firm's in-house manufacturing strengths.
The moulded insole sits on the home page in both years and has a concrete customer reference (the FIT-DAY at ALBA Braunschweig), so results clearly exceed the aspiration.
